segments.source: I will tell of Partridge who had a discussion with Turtle.
Partridge said: “Thou, friend Turtle, never canst run away.
When the fire is coming into the land, thou art always burnt.”
Turtle said : “ I cannot be burnt.
Partridge said : “ I have my wings ; I fly.
Thou canst not fly, canst not run ; thou shalt burn just here, (in this) very same place.”
They spent days ; the dry season came.
The fires begin over the country.
The bush, where are Turtle and Partridge, it is set on fire.
